## Summary Review of a new caller of the reusable Daily Release (pm-ado#131, pinned to v2026.11.22, `1d9f9daba721f2cb8bec4aef69ca54402b08350e`) raised an interruption point in `daily-release.ts` that the callers cannot fix: If a candidate refresh is cancelled **after the force-push of the release branch and before the release PR body (the receipt) is updated**, the PR points at the new head while its receipt still names the old head. The next run refuses the head mismatch. `retire-unpublished` applies the same head check, so it cannot clear the state either. The release stays blocked after the original cause is gone. This is a sibling of #314 (an interrupted `retire-unpublished` cannot be completed by a retry): both are a two-step transition with no record that lets a later run finish or roll back the first step. ## Acceptance - The refresh records its intended head transition (old head, new head, run id) before the force-push, in a place the next run reads, so a later run can finish the receipt update for exactly that transition or roll the branch back. - An unrelated head change is still refused, and auto-merge is never enabled while the live head and the verified receipt differ. - A test interrupts the refresh between the push and the body update and proves that the next scheduled run completes the transition, and that `retire-unpublished` can retire the candidate. - All callers get the fix through the normal pin bump; no caller change is needed. ## Scope Every package that calls the reusable flow (28 repositories at the moment) inherits this. --- ### GitHub comments (2) > **@coderabbitai[bot]** (2026-11-24T21:58:01Z) > > > > >

Drop into our [discord](https://discord.gg/coderabbit)! > **@unbraind** (2026-11-25T00:19:51Z) > > A second interruption point of the same class, from the next review of pm-ado#131: the prepare step pushes `release/VERSION` before `gh pr create`. If the PR creation fails, the branch exists without a PR. A retry that selects the same branch stops at the `retired-branch` check, because there is no PR carrying a retirement receipt, and `retire-unpublished` cannot clear it because it discovers receipts only on PRs. The recorded transition asked for above should cover it: a branch this intent pushed (same version, same head, no PR yet) must be resumable to PR creation, while a foreign branch of that name is still refused. Add a test that fails PR creation after the push and proves the next run opens the PR.
Daily Release: a candidate refresh interrupted between the force-push and the receipt update blocks the release, and retire-unpublished cannot clear it
